reviewNotes: Reviewed every exported speech key against all 20 cards in data/pages73.json, accepted vocabulary/furigana and sentence context. Checked ふりそで, せせり, そりれす, ぼんじり, 手羽元 てばもと, 手羽中 てばなか, 手羽先 てばさき, 砂肝 すなぎも, 雌鶏 めんどり and 雄鶏 おんどり, and anatomy readings including みせいじゅくらんおう, らんかん, こつばん and だいどうみゃく. Converted loanwords to hiragana preserving レバー long vowels; paired cut names use pauses. Reviewed topic は→わ and object を→お in context; no directional へ occurs. Preserved lexical はつ and はつもと. Mixed English glosses use Japanese-only inputs: omit the drumette gloss sentence; chicken is rendered よびかた; omit hen/rooster and their redundant つまり while retaining the complete Japanese identification. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. All questions and full explanations use generation speed 1.0, including the short recurring question; cut names and short vocabulary groups use 0.85. No listening or audible pitch-accent verification performed.
